title: Fresh Mint Sorbet
changes_from_base: A fresh mint syrup made on the hob and sharpened with lemon replaces the fruit; no corn syrup.
summary: Clean and cooling: a syrup steeped with whole bunches of fresh mint, sharpened with lemon juice and churned.

ingredients.item: large bunches fresh mint, stems on (about 60 g)

steps.title: Dissolve
steps.text: Stir the sugar into the water in the pan over medium heat until the base is free of grains, then bring to the boil.

steps.title: Steep
steps.text: Push the mint into the syrup, take it off the heat, cover and leave until cool, about 1 h.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour through the sieve, pressing the leaves to get every drop, then chill for several hours or overnight.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Whisk in the lemon juice and churn for 20-25 min.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for 2 h. Serve in small glasses with a mint sprig.

tips: Spearmint gives a sweet, classic flavour.
Do not boil the mint in the syrup; steeping off the heat keeps it fresh.
Serve as a palate cleanser in small glasses.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
